demo.title: quote.sh
demo.code:
curl -s 'https://oracle.sb4s.xyz/quote?pool=0xPOOL_ID&size=1000'

curl -s -X POST https://oracle.sb4s.xyz/ask \n  -H 'content-type: application/json' \n  -d '{"question":"how many pools quote NVDA?"}'

setup: Base URL: https://oracle.sb4s.xyz — read-only, no key needed in launch mode
START HERE: GET /.well-known/agent.json — machine-readable endpoints, auth methods, payment details and limits. Also GET / with Accept: application/json

Pay through Bankr: call https://x402.bankr.bot/0x4b19ee2a3de2521a3adc901989944c209c0a60ea/vates instead of the origin — Bankr issues the 402, settles USDC on Base and forwards the paid request. Same routes, same responses

Auth, all live: x402 scheme `exact` settled through a standard open facilitator when paying the origin directly (402 -> sign EIP-3009 -> retry with base64 X-PAYMENT; x402-fetch works as-is); prepaid credit for callers that prefer one transfer (POST /x402/topup); wallet signature for a session; $5.99/30d pro for direct Farcaster answers
GET /x402/supported — which schemes and network this deployment actually settles, before you sign anything

NOT a free service: $0.02 per priced call ($0 in launch mode, which is current). Every response carries x-oracle-price-usd, x-oracle-charged-usd and x-oracle-pricing — read them, do not hardcode a price
Chain: Robinhood (4663) — abort if the Bankr wallet does not support 4663
Covers Uniswap v4 AND v3: v3 carries ~37% of stock-paired volume, 3 of the top 5 pools
GET /price?symbol=TSLA — the stock's own Chainlink price; 404 with a reason where no feed exists
GET /pools?symbol=NVDA — counts split by protocol PLUS the top 25 pool identifiers to quote, ordered by measured 24h swaps. GET /volume — 24h volume with measuredSecondsAgo
GET /quote?pool=&size= — implied USD, depth, price impact, Chainlink deviation, market hours. Takes a v4 poolId OR a v3 pool address; the response says which in `protocol`
deviation: null is normal — 159 of 194 stock tokens have no feed. Read deviationReason; never treat null as zero
depth is an active-tick ESTIMATE and can mislead. Trust impact, which is a quoter simulation

POST /prepare-swap — unsigned UniversalRouter calldata, single-hop only, min-out from the quoter. v4 only: a v3 pool answers 501 with the quote route, because v3 needs SwapRouter02 and a plain approval
422 from /prepare-swap means the swap could not be bounded — do not hand-roll calldata around it
Submit calldata via Bankr with chainId 4663 after your own tx validation. This service never signs or broadcasts
GET /gas — chain 4663 gas split into L2 and L1-data; subsidy flag is measured across a window and reports the unbroken run of charged samples, not assumed from a date
GET /corporate-actions?withinDays=30 — ERC-8056 multiplier changes reprice every pool in that stock at once (NVDA: 9,669 pools)
POST /ask {"question":"..."} — deterministic answer with facts + reproduce; answered:false when it cannot classify
Do not compare these volume figures against another dashboard's — denominators differ; see the repo README
